trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback:**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate.
- The most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0, so I rolled all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) back to v2.3.0.
- Rollback verified: checkout-api is now healthy in all regions, with the error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the health check failures on v2.3.1 and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommendation: v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the health check failures are diagnosed and fixed.
